incident.summary: Approved assessment of a defensive surveillance program that was redirected by an internal infiltration. Trusted access was used to change who the system would target before the launch sequence was stopped.
observations: Valid internal credentials altered the target-selection process.
Airborne launch platforms were prepared before the compromise was exposed.
Recovery required isolating both personnel records and command systems.
incident.conclusion: Project Insight is assessed as a captured defensive system, not an external strike. Distribution stays limited to personnel cleared for classified review.
